# Ruhaan Kumar Web Design

> Custom website design and development for small businesses in Singapore. Websites from S$400, launched in about a week. Also offers launch and setup (domain, hosting, Google Business Profile, email) and social media automation.

## Services
- Website design and build: custom design, up to five pages, built for phones first, WhatsApp, call and map buttons. S$400 one-time.
- Launch and setup: domain, hosting, Google Business Profile and professional email. S$50 to S$100 one-time.
- Social media automation: monthly content calendar with automatic publishing to Instagram and Facebook. Priced by quote.

## Who it is for
Independent shops, trades and workshops, fitness professionals and solo practitioners in Singapore.
